name: dev-memory-prose-format-rule
title: Stop dev-memory prose from carrying self-referential absolution and volatile embedded values
description: A dev-memory correction chain on story B-9ff1 failed to converge: entries kept asserting that their own text was free of some property, and a correction pasted a live retrieval result that went stale within the same session. Both are format properties rather than lapses of care - several offending entries state the convention in their own body while violating it. Deferred from B-9ff1:F-076 and B-9ff1:F-077, with the reviewing lane judging deferral acceptable and recommending a structural rule over another manual correction.
source: B-9ff1:F-076 and B-9ff1:F-077 (concept lane), deferred with the lane judging another in-story correction would repeat the pattern rather than end it
